title: connector.sync_job_error

connector_sync_job_id.description: The unique identifier for the connector sync job.

error.description: The error for the connector sync job error field.

description:
Set a connector sync job error.

Set the `error` field for a connector sync job and set its `status` to `error`.

To sync data using self-managed connectors, you need to deploy the Elastic connector service on your own infrastructure.
This service runs automatically on Elastic Cloud for Elastic managed connectors.
